title: Spain: RPP registration and SCRAP membership
summary: A business placing packaging on the Spanish market must be entered in the Registro de Productores de Producto (packaging section) held by MITECO, join a collective scheme (SCRAP) such as Ecoembes or Ecovidrio, and file an annual declaration. There is no volume threshold — the duty applies from the first unit.
